newsitem.title: USA: Ryder explores options for auto carrier unit.
newsitem.headline: Ryder explores options for auto carrier unit.

text.p: Ryder System Inc said on Thursday that it has hired an adviser to help it explore strategic options for its Automotive Carrier Services business unit.

The company reiterated that its focus is on the integrated logistics and truck leasing and rental market. "Consistent with this strategy, we need to restore the financial performance of Automotive Carrier Services. Our adviser will help us explore all aspects of the business and develop strategic options," the company stated.
The company would know what the options are in 1997 at the earliest, a company spokesman said. He declined to disclose the advising company.
